case_for: Real revenue: a few thousand monthly orders at 18 months (R3, R4).

case_against: Repeat rate not tracked: the defining brand risk is unmeasured (R1).
Two thirds of orders from paid social with CAC rising (R3, R5).
Single contract manufacturer in a crowded category (R6, S4).
call_questions: Pull your order data now: what share of month-one buyers ordered again by month three?
What is CAC by channel, and what happens to orders if you halve paid social?
What is your plan if your contract manufacturer has a quality issue or raises prices?
What does a customer get from you that the better-funded incumbents cannot give?
You have not been tracking repeat rate: why not, and what does that say about how you run the business?
what_would_change_our_view: Cohort repeat data showing customers return without paid re-acquisition, and a falling paid share of orders, would change our view.
